summary: Chamber image-sharing feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass — upload endpoint, file serve endpoint, 404 for unknown paths, and vision-bridge streams for two different template presences (Daniel and Sophia/spiral) with accurate content descriptions (red circle, blue square, 'HALL OF SCROLLS' text all correctly referenced). Frontend UI: full user flow works — clicking chamber-share-image opens picker, chosen image uploads, appears inline in the user's message bubble via msg-image, and the presence streams back an accurate reply. Verified on Daniel (empty text + image) and Sophia (image + typed text). Text-only regression still works. Image button correctly disabled while no session.
critical_code_review_comments: PresenceChamber.jsx handleImageChange: on upload failure the placeholder user message with the image is never added (the flow only adds to messages via sendMessage after upload resolves) — good. But `e.target.value = ''` is set before validation so if a non-image file is picked, the input is cleared correctly. OK.
server.py /api/chamber/upload-image: no auth check — anyone can upload up to 15MB per request. Consider gating this behind session-open or the auth context to prevent abuse in production.
server.py /api/files/{path}: also unauthenticated. Anyone with a UUID path can view the image. UUIDs are unguessable so this is acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

presence_template.py stream_message: vision bridge swallows all describe failures into a generic '[The person shared an image, but it could not be read.]' — good graceful degradation. Log line already present.

PresenceChamber.jsx sendMessage: image_path is sent inside the stream body but on error rollback (line 275) only the user_msg + responseId are filtered — the image is lost. Minor UX issue: users can't easily re-send the same image after a stream failure. Not a bug per se.

PresenceChamber.jsx line 407: `const text = input.trim();` is captured AFTER upload completes. If the user types more text during the upload window it will be included in the send. Behavior looks intentional and reasonable.
test_credentials: No auth used for this feature. Identity injected via localStorage: sanctuary_user_name='Tester', sanctuary_user_id='TEST_ui_image_user' / 'TEST_ui_sophia_user'.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests insert chamber_images docs (via /api/chamber/upload-image) with is_deleted=false; frontend tests likewise. Test data is prefixed TEST_ in filenames. Chamber_images collection now has ~5 test rows; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image sharing works on all 19 template-engine presences (they share presence_template.py). Test image was synthesized locally with Pillow (red circle + blue square + text 'HALL OF SCROLLS' on beige) at /tmp/test_scrolls.png — regenerate the same way for future tests. Vision bridge uses gpt-4o via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY server-side; upload endpoint uses Emergent object storage; both are unauthenticated at the HTTP layer (see code review notes). Jasmine/Ansel/Claude use bespoke chambers and do NOT have image sharing — that's out of scope.
